label: Package returns with no questionnaire in it
description: The service answers successfully and the package holds a library but no questionnaire. It has said nothing about what documentation is wanted: this is not the same as answering that none is.
basis: Synthetic. Built from this tool's reading of Da Vinci DTR and SDC. It has not been observed from the live service.
assumption: How the live service answers when it has no questionnaire for an order is not known. This file models a successful answer whose package bundle holds a library and no questionnaire.
